text:
QUOTE: "**Compile-time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` and define `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO` ... **Run-time.** Enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, then call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names both the compile-time macro pair and the run-time function-pointer pair, but never says they are mutually exclusive. It also describes the runtime pointers as the default target of the macro path, which implies they work together.
